title: Managed Database: retention statement reconciliation — assessment outcome
content:
## Assessment basis
Managed Database retention statement reconciliation uses the following assessment outcome basis. Subtract native allocation and the smaller of completed external allocation and external protected capacity from measured retained quantity; floor the final remainder at zero and round half-up once to six decimal GB-month places. This is the remaining native retained-storage entitlement quantity displayed by the reconciled statement.

## Hypothetical calculation
Hypothetical inputs: measured retention is 200 GB-month, completed native allocation is 30 GB-month, completed external allocation is 90 GB-month and protected capacity is 70 GB-month. The external deduction is 70, leaving 100.000000 GB-month. Deducting the uncapped external allocation would incorrectly leave 80.000000 GB-month.
